data.title: 塔露拉 · 炽热温泉湿身扶石回眸的龙尾交缠
data.description: 隐秘地热溶洞中的私人温泉，翻滚的水汽中弥漫着矿石与源石的温热气息。塔露拉褪尽衣物伏在温热的天然石台上，如瀑银灰湿发贴在光洁美背上。她回过头来，金瞳里满是湿润的迷乱与动摇，细长的龙尾轻轻勾住你的小腿，在水汽蒸腾中迎向滚烫的拥抱。
data.location: 地热溶洞深处的私人天然石穴温泉
data.action: 双手扶石台伏卧，湿发贴背，回眸娇喘，龙尾勾缠依偎
data.lighting: 溶洞天然发光萤石与地热红光的幽暗辉映
data.camera: cowboy shot, from behind, looking over shoulder
data.promptProse: Leaning forward against the smooth hot spring ledge, water cascades down her arched, unclad back and silver hair. Amber cave minerals reflect in the vapor as she glances back with parted lips, her tail gently encircling the viewer's ankle.
data.animaCaption: She leans over the steamy hot spring rock, looking back over her bare shoulder with glassy golden eyes.
